# Samsul Arifin — Professional Portfolio

> Samsul Arifin is an Operations Systems & Automation Specialist based in Sidoarjo, Indonesia. He maps field operations, roles, controls, exceptions, and data requirements, then uses AI-assisted delivery to turn them into practical business systems.

## Professional focus

- Business process improvement and process mapping
- Operational excellence and operational controls
- Business systems analysis, requirements, and UAT
- Operations transformation and workflow automation
- KPI, reporting, inventory, logistics, sales, and field operations
- AI-assisted application delivery

## Verified portfolio outcomes

- Built an integrated sales tools ecosystem used by more than 70 active users.
- Helped reduce the logistics cost ratio from 5% in Q4 2024 to 2.8% in Q1 2025.
- Coordinated the resolution of a Rp1.3 billion returns backlog within one week.
- Created four featured operational products: GeoLead, Kayou POS, KLWT Surveyor, and Narotama Workforce.
